Name: Chaos's Blue Whio Duck
Author: kichigaikikyokagome
Description:
This replaced the default duck. Its a recolor based on the endangered Blue Duck (Whio Duck) of New Zealand.

Directions:
1. Extract my files somewhere.

If Using Stardew Valley Mod Manager - 
3. Open SVMM. Click "Add SMAPI/XNB Mod"
4. Navigate to my extracted files. Open the folder. At the bottom, change "file name" to ".xnb" to view all .xnb files in the folder. Highlight all the duck.xnb file. Click "Open". Select "animal".


OR Manual install:
3. Back-up any original game files before replacing them.  
4. Drag and drop my duck.xnb file into the Stardew Valley game folder > Content > Animals
4. Allow my file to overwrite.


Enjoy!
Also check out Bearded D'uccle - Chaos's Chicken Breed Replacer mod to swap your ugly chooks for the beautiful exhibition breed, because you deserve gorgeous poultry.
